children: A federal judge on Tuesday allowed President Donald Trump’s $10B defamation lawsuit against the BBC over an edited speech clip to proceed, while dismissing his unfair trade practices claim against the broadcaster.
Trump is suing Britain’s publicly funded broadcaster for at least $10B over edited clips of a speech that made it appear he directed supporters ​to storm the US Capitol on January 6, 2021.

U.S. District Judge Jeffrey Kuntz in Florida rejected the BBC’s bid to dismiss Trump’s defamation claim, finding that he had plausibly argued the broadcaster harmed his reputation and knew or should have known the edited clip was misleading. The ruling does not determine whether Trump can ultimately prove his allegations, according to reports.

title: Judge allows Trump’s $10B defamation lawsuit against BBC to move forward
